title: Approver receives a bell notification when a new NCCM approval request is raised

steps.action: Login as an approver; have another user raise a new NCCM approval request
steps.expected: Request is created

steps.action: Open Alerts and Notifications (bell icon)
steps.expected: A notification for the new approval request is present

title: Notifications appear under a section named "Approval Notification"

steps.action: Open the bell as a user with approval rights and at least one pending request
steps.expected: Panel opens

steps.action: Read the section headings
steps.expected: A section titled exactly "Approval Notification" exists alongside the existing sections

title: Approval Notification section shows the pending count

steps.action: Ensure exactly 3 approval requests are pending for the logged-in approver, then open the bell
steps.expected: Panel opens

steps.action: Read the section header count
steps.expected: It reads 3, matching the pending approval requests

title: Each entry shows Request Name, Requested By, Timestamp, Description and Status

steps.action: Open the Approval Notification section
steps.expected: Entries are listed

steps.action: Inspect one entry
steps.expected: All five fields are present and populated: Request Name, Requested By, Timestamp, Description, Status

title: Section layout matches the Figma reference

steps.action: Open the Approval Notification section
steps.expected: Section renders

steps.action: Compare against Figma node-id 8640-112388 in the NCCM file
steps.expected: Section placement, count badge, row layout, field order and spacing match the design

title: Only users with approval rights receive the notification

steps.action: Raise an NCCM approval request, then open the bell as a user WITHOUT approval rights
steps.expected: Panel opens

steps.action: Look for an Approval Notification section or entry
steps.expected: Neither is shown — the notification targets only users holding approval rights

title: Count decreases once a request is approved or rejected

steps.action: Note the Approval Notification count, then approve one of the pending requests
steps.expected: Approval completes

steps.action: Re-open the bell
steps.expected: The count has decreased by one and the decided request is no longer listed as pending

title: Clicking a notification navigates to the approval request

steps.action: Open the Approval Notification section and click an entry
steps.expected: Navigation occurs

steps.action: Inspect the destination
steps.expected: The corresponding NCCM approval request opens ready to action — confirm the intended target screen against Figma

title: Section is absent or empty-stated when nothing is pending

steps.action: As an approver with no pending approval requests, open the bell
steps.expected: Panel opens

steps.action: Inspect the Approval Notification area
steps.expected: Either the section is hidden or it shows a zero count with an empty state — not a broken or blank block

steps.action: Note the bell contents (alerts and other existing sections) before the change
steps.expected: Baseline captured

steps.action: Re-open the bell after the change
steps.expected: All pre-existing sections and their counts behave as before; only the new section is added

title: Notification arrives in real time without a page reload

steps.action: Keep the bell panel open as an approver while another user raises a request
steps.expected: Request is created

steps.action: Watch the panel
steps.expected: The new entry and the incremented count appear without a manual refresh

title: Long request names and descriptions do not break the layout

steps.action: Raise a request with a 255-character name and a long multi-line description
steps.expected: Request is created

steps.action: Open the Approval Notification section
steps.expected: Text truncates or wraps within the row; the panel does not overflow horizontally and the other fields stay readable

title: Timestamp respects the user timezone and format convention

steps.action: Raise a request, then view its notification as users in two different timezone settings
steps.expected: Both see the entry

steps.action: Compare the timestamps
steps.expected: Each renders in the viewing user's timezone using the product's standard date-time format

title: Many pending approvals paginate or scroll rather than flooding the panel

steps.action: Create 50 pending approval requests for one approver and open the bell
steps.expected: Panel opens

steps.action: Inspect the section
steps.expected: Entries scroll or paginate with the true count shown; the panel opens promptly and stays usable

steps.expected: Request is created

steps.action: Open the Approval Notification section
steps.expected: The value renders escaped as literal text; no script executes

title: Bulk approval requests are represented sensibly in the section

steps.action: Raise a bulk NCCM approval request spanning 20 devices (see MOTADATA-9631) and open the bell
steps.expected: Notification appears

steps.action: Inspect the entry
steps.expected: One entry represents the bulk request rather than 20 separate entries — confirm the intended behaviour with the team, as the bulk ticket has an unresolved per-device vs single notification dispute
